description: Pull incoming citations, outgoing references, counts, a single citation edge, a full citation graph, or bibliographic metadata for one or more scholarly identifiers from the open OpenCitations APIs.

identifiers.description: One or more DOIs, DOI URLs, PMIDs, OMIDs, ISSNs or ISBNs. DOI URLs and bare IDs are normalised automatically. Use `oci` instead for the single-citation mode.
identifiers.title: Identifiers

includeWorkMetadata.description: Add citingTitle, citingAuthors, citingPubDate, citingVenue and the cited equivalents to citation/reference/graph rows using OpenCitations Meta. Off by default because it adds metadata requests.
includeWorkMetadata.title: Include work metadata on edges

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Edge modes page through results until this cap; count and metadata modes process at most this many identifiers.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to retrieve. Edge modes page through the OpenCitations Index; count and metadata modes return one record per identifier.
enumTitles: Citations — works that cite the identifier
Citation count — how many works cite it
Reference count — how many works it cites
Both counts — citation and reference counts
Venue citation count — citations to a journal ISSN
Single citation edge — look up one OCI
mode.title: Mode

oci.description: Open Citation Identifier for mode=getCitation, with or without the `oci:` prefix (e.g. `06101801781-06180334099`).
oci.title: OCI (single citation mode)

startPage.description: Page to start from for citation/reference/graph modes. Each page holds up to 1,000 edges. Use it to resume large graphs or fetch a specific slice.
startPage.title: Start page

title: OpenCitations DOI Citation Graph Input
